claims.text: Sxtomatic outflow-tract VT in an otherwise norm ♡: a BB or a CCB = useful.
claims.quote: In patients with symptomatic outflow tract VT in an otherwise normal heart, a beta blocker or a calcium channel blocker is useful

claims.text: Sustained, tolerated verapamil-sensitive idiopathic LV VT (interfascicular reentry): IV verapamil to terminate.
claims.quote: In patients with sustained hemodynamically tolerated verapamil-sensitive, idiopathic LVT related to interfascicular reentry, intravenous verapamil is recommended for VT termination

claims.text: Never for wide-QRS tachy of unknown origin: CCBs (verapamil, diltiazem) are potentially harmful.
claims.quote: In patients with a wide QRS complex tachycardia of unknown origin, calcium channel blockers (e.g., verapamil and diltiazem) are potentially harmful
